artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village with thatched and shingle roofed cottages surrounded by trees. A person is gathering or working with sticks in the middle distance. At the horizon, there is a large weathered building partly obscured by trees. The etching is detailed and uses fine lines to depict textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using brown ink lines to create light and shadow, enhancing the tranquil mood of the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a village or church in the distance. The horizon line is positioned at the lower third of the image. In the foreground, there is a figure sitting on a grassy mound. The drawing uses fine linework with cross-hatching to create texture, particularly in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, resembling traditional etchings and pencil drawings. Vegetation frames the scene on both sides against the sky.

artworks.title: Sir Charles Holroyd
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile view, with a strong facial profile featuring prominent cheekbones and a sharp nose. His hair is neatly styled, combed back and appears wavy. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a suit, with a large bow or cravat tied at the neck. The artwork is a detailed monochrome presentation, possibly an etching or line drawing. The plain background directs focus on the subject. There are no visible jewelry, and the simplicity of the background enhances the portrait's classical style.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Chateau (Les ruines du chateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with an old, crumbling building partially covered by foliage. The horizon is rocky, with hills rising behind the ruins. The sky has sweeping lines indicating clouds. The etching lines are textured, with dense cross-hatching and contour-hatching depicting shadows and form. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, creating a chiaroscuro effect. On the right, a tree frames the scene with intricate leaf patterns.

artworks.title: Valley of Veronne (La vallee de Veronne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. A house is located towards the upper left corner, surrounded by trees and bushes trailing along the slopes to the right. The horizon runs smoothly across the middle. The sky above is mostly clear, with some thin, horizontal cloud lines. The artwork is created with line-based techniques, including cross-hatching for depth and texture, indicative of a detailed etching style. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily sepia tones, lending a muted and aged appearance to the landscape.

artworks.title: Hut in the Marsh (Cabane dans les marais)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a low horizon, an expansive sky dominating the frame. Thin, linear strokes cross the sky. Foliage forms a barrier in the foreground. Structures with steep roofs are nestled among vegetation on rolling hills. In the distance, hills and geometric forms suggest buildings or siloes. The palette is monochromatic, emphasizing depth with varying intensities of ink.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching shows a landscape with ancient ruins dominating the scene. The horizon is centered, with distant hills and derelict towers against the sky. Cross-hatching techniques create texture for shadow and light. Fine lines depict the terrain and sky, giving depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia and black. Closest to us, hills and shrubs lead to the ruins, partially covered by foliage. The image suggests the passage of time on manmade structures. The scene evokes timelessness and quiet contemplation.

artworks.title: Ruins of an Ancient Aqueduct (Ruine d'un ancien aqueduc)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a forested area with dense, dark trees. A bright opening in the foliage reveals a view of the horizon. The trees and possibly rocks or structures form an archway framing the distant horizon. The artwork is created using detailed hatching for texture and depth, typical of etching. The color palette consists of monochromatic tones of deep blacks, browns, and varying shades of gray, contrasting with the lighter area beyond the archway.

artworks.title: Sleeper (Un dormeur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a seated person leaning forward with their head resting on crossed arms. The person's face is turned downward, with a beard and short, textured hair visible. They are wearing a long-sleeved garment. The background is sketched with lines, giving the impression of fabric or texture. There are no additional objects in the image. In the lower left corner, the initials "A.L." are visible alongside a signature.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds (L'adoration des bergers)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The composition depicts figures gathered closely around a central light source. Above them, there are angelic figures. The drawing is highly detailed, with strong contrasts between light and shadow. The architectural elements suggest an indoor setting, while the expressions and gestures of the figures convey a sense of wonder and reverence.

artworks.title: G.F. Watts, R.A., 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait drawing of an older man. The man faces forward with a slight turn to his left, looking directly at the viewer. He has deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a full, long beard indicating advanced age. He wears a cap and a heavy coat or robe with the collar visible. His gray, thinning hair is visible in wisps at the sides. The background is plain with subtle cross-hatching for texture, focusing on the man's face and upper body.

artworks.title: Mlle. Simpson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing showing a head portrait. The focus is on the face, emphasizing the eyes and gentle expression. The individual is depicted in a frontal pose, facing directly forward. The hairstyle features short, soft waves and curls framing the face. The eyebrows are well-defined, and the lips are gently closed, contributing to the serene expression. Clothing is barely visible, with only a suggestion of a high collar at the base of the neck. The background is plain off-white. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The signature "A. Legros" is noted in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: View of a Chateau (Chateau de Poillet)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees and a distant structure. The horizon is visible at the upper part of the image, showing a building with a pointed roof among the trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture for the foliage and light play. The color scheme is black and white, using etching techniques for depth. Closest to us is a shadowy area with plants on a path. Light shines from the top right corner, illuminating leaves and casting shadows.

artworks.title: Beggars of Brussels (Les mendiants de Bruges)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central figure with a basket. The scene captures an intense moment, likely set in a historical or rustic context. Individuals show varying expressions. The central figure seems to be distributing goods. The scene is rendered in an intricate style with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Village of Saint-Pierre during a Storm (Village de Saint-Pierre; Effet d'orage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rustic village on a hill. Several buildings with thatched roofs are clustered together. The land slopes upward towards the structures, with textured clouds in the sky. The etching technique uses fine lines to define forms. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow. A figure is bending down, possibly tending to the land.

artworks.title: Mme. Kemp, 4th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's head and upper shoulders. The individual is facing slightly to the left with their face in a side profile. The facial features include rounded eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth, surrounded by a few wrinkles. The person's hair is pulled back in a bun at the top of the head. They are wearing a high-collared garment with a visible band or clasp at the neckline. The background is plain with shading and cross-hatching for texture around the head.

artworks.title: Return of the Peasants (Le retour des paysans)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures engaged in work or movement. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with a high horizon below faintly sketched hills in the background. Delicate and detailed pencil strokes emphasize texture and create a sense of motion among the figures. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of grey. In the distance, there are rolling hills and vegetation, becoming lighter and less defined as they recede into the background.

artworks.title: Return from the Woods (Le retour du bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with detailed elements viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is visible near the top, featuring rooftops and a cloudy sky. Two figures are depicted, one crouching with a cloak and the other leaning on a walking stick. The background includes a rugged landscape with mounds, foliage, and rustic structures. The rooftops, shrubbery, and trees create layers leading back to the horizon. The etching technique is evident, with carefully etched lines defining forms and textures. The black and white palette enhances the details and creates a high contrast.

artworks.title: At the Foot of the Cross (Au pied de la croix)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on the ground with hands clasped together in front of their face. The person is wearing a hooded garment and a long dress, with a stick on the ground next to them. In the background, there is a large stone or pedestal structure and a faint outline of a hilly landscape. The image has a sketch-like quality with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Manger (La creche)
artworks.medium: etching in green touched with green wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in profile, possibly full-length but partially obscured, situated towards the left side of the scene. The first figure is an elderly person, bent over and reaching forward with clasped hands. This person has pronounced facial features with a prominent nose, and their hair is completely covered by a headscarf. Their clothing consists of a long, flowing robe or cloak with substantial folds. The second figure, standing slightly behind and to the left, also has their hair covered by a cloth, and wears a similar long robe. This person's facial features are less distinct due to the angle but appear younger than the first figure. A small child is on the right side of the image, reclining in a crib filled with hay. The child is positioned with legs bent, arms slightly raised, and has a small, circular halo above their head. In the lower right foreground, a basket and a simple shepherd's crook are visible. The background is composed of a textured, cross-hatched pattern, possibly indicating a stone wall, and in the upper right, a simple light source emits rays, illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: The Manger (La creche)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: Two figures in profile are depicted from the waist up. The figure on the left is slightly behind, holding a lit candle. The person has distinct facial features and wears a head covering with visible patterns suggesting a textured fabric. The figure on the right appears slightly bowed and is also wearing a hooded garment that drapes over their head and shoulders, enveloping them in shadowed folds. The setting is dimly lit, possibly suggesting an enclosed space, with a background marked by cross-hatched lines creating a textured appearance. The interplay of light from the candle casts stark shadows, creating a dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Along the Top of the Hill (Sur le haut de la colline)
artworks.medium: etching retouched with crayon and ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a solitary figure leaning on a stick, looking towards the left. In the background, there is a low horizon with a sky dominating the composition. To the right, there is a rustic structure with a slanted roof, shrubbery, and a stylized tree. The artwork uses fine, detailed etching techniques with cross-hatched lines to depict texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones adding contrast.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Boy in a Tree (Paysage avec un garcon grimpe sur un arbre, dite "Le denicheur d'oiseaux")
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated in a tree. The person is positioned with their back against the trunk, legs dangling down on either side of the branch, and head tilted downwards. It appears they are wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Their clothing is simple, possibly long-sleeved and loosely fitted. At the base of the tree, there is a staff or walking stick. The setting is a detailed natural landscape with dense foliage, other large trees, and a peaceful forest atmosphere.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Peasant and Fortune (Le paysan et la fortune: Sujet allegorique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a simple house in the distance, trees partially obscuring it. The etching technique is evident with detailed lines creating texture. Three figures are present: a man with a walking stick, a seated woman holding a child, and an ethereal figure in the clouds. The man appears to look towards the ethereal figure. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of brown and beige. The etched lines vary in thickness and direction, adding depth to the composition.
